lfk-baidu-1.webp.zh: 一架塞斯纳小飞机正在进近：机翼下是草地跑道与锈红色的水塔，机场的乡野气息扑面而来。
lfk-baidu-1.webp.en: A Cessna on final approach — the grass strip and a rust-red water tower under its wing, the field's rural character in one frame.

lfk-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 晴空下，浅色航站楼的外墙上用深色字母写着机场名称，绿屋顶下种着修剪整齐的灌木。
lfk-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Against a clear blue sky the terminal's pale wall carries the airport's name in dark letters, low shrubs trimmed along the green-roofed building.

lfk-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 深色的跑道入口上，白色的箭头标志与黄色引导线清晰可见，远处草色枯黄。
lfk-chatgpt-02.webp.en: White chevrons and yellow guidance lines mark the dark runway threshold, with dry grass stretching towards a tree line in the distance.

lfk-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 一架酒红色与白色相间的单发螺旋桨小飞机停在机坪上，身后是通讯塔和绿顶航站楼。
lfk-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A maroon and white single-engine propeller aircraft rests on the apron, with a radio tower and a green-roofed terminal behind it.

lfk-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 阴天下，一架双发涡桨飞机停在敞开的机库门口，库门内侧的钢架结构清晰可见。
lfk-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Under a grey sky a twin-turboprop aircraft sits in the open doorway of a hangar, its dark steel roof frame visible inside.

lfk-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 从正上方俯瞰，一架白色高翼单发小飞机停在水泥机坪上，机腹与机翼投下清晰的影子。
lfk-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Seen from directly above, a white high-wing single-engine aircraft stands on a concrete apron, casting a crisp shadow across the slabs.

lfk-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 航站楼白墙上的绿色字母写着机场名称，下方挂着两块年度机场纪念牌，前面是灌木丛。
lfk-chatgpt-06.webp.en: Green letters on the terminal's cream wall spell the airport's name above two framed airport-of-the-year plaques, with clipped hedges below.

lfk-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 电视新闻画面里，两架小型双发飞机停在机库中，机身被千斤顶支起，屏幕下方是天气预报条。
lfk-chatgpt-07.webp.en: A television news frame shows two small twin-engine aircraft inside a hangar, one propped on jacks, above a weather forecast banner.
